source_contract.toller_gamma_simple_formula: For k=j=l and rho=gamma*j, Eq. (46) of Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal arXiv:2604.24945 has hypergeometric parameters with c-a-b=-(2j+1) for either Toller branch; source examples at j=1/2 and j=1 exhibit inverse powers sinh(beta)^-2 and sinh(beta)^-3.
source_contract.boost_coset_measure: Kaminski arXiv:1010.5384 decomposes SL(2,C) Haar measure into normalized SU(2) measure times the measure on SL(2,C)/SU(2)=H_+, a three-dimensional hyperboloid. Near coincident boost points, the noncompact local dimension per independent vertex is 3.
source_contract.graph: The Lorentzian 4-simplex vertex graph is K5 with five nodes and ten edges; after one gauge-fixed node there are four independent noncompact H_+ variables.
source_contract.scope: This is a component-level superficial degree audit. It identifies where fixed-branch local singularities can overwhelm noncompact measure before magnetic/intertwiner cancellations. It does not establish divergence of the fully contracted causal vertex.

scope_rule: A PASS establishes a local singularity risk map and selects the next decisive object: the leading fixed-branch K5 tensor after SU(2)-invariant intertwiner contraction. It must not be promoted to full-vertex divergence, family failure, NEW_REQUIRED, or D7 authorization.
